description.raw: '''Innate:''' Upon taking [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|fatal damage]], '''Kog'Maw''' enters a [[File:Zombie icon.png|20px|link=Death#Zombie_states|An icon representing the keyword Zombie state]] [[:Death#Zombie_states|zombie state]] for 4 seconds, becoming [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosted]] and gaining [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 10% '''bonus''' movement speed that increases up to 50% over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes to deal [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] 140 – 650 (based on level) true damage to nearby enemies.
description.text: Innate: Upon taking fatal damage, Kog'Maw enters a zombie state for 4 seconds, becoming ghosted and gaining  10% bonus movement speed that increases up to 50% over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes to deal  140 – 650 (based on level) true damage to nearby enemies.

description2.raw: While under this state, '''Kog'Maw''' becomes [[File:Cosmic Radiance.png|20px|link=Invulnerability|An icon representing the keyword Invulnerability]] [[:Invulnerability|invulnerable]], [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], and [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|immune to crowd control]], but is also rendered unable to declare [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]], cast [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]], use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[active ability items|activate items]].
description2.text: While under this state, Kog'Maw becomes invulnerable, untargetable, and immune to crowd control, but is also rendered unable to declare basic attacks, cast abilities, use summoner spells, and activate items.

notes.text:
Icathian Surprise's bonus movement speed increases by 2.5% every 0.264 seconds over the duration, up to the maximum of 50%. However, as a result of the ticks being rounded up from 0.25 seconds, the movement speed only reaches up to 45%.
Icathian Surprise's untargetability does not destroy in-flight projectiles.
Icathian Surprise will still trigger if Kog'Maw is killed by the Nexus Obelisk.
If Kog'Maw has the missile from a basic attack in-flight at the same time that he's moving while he dies, as long as the missile hits the target after Icathian Surprise has started, Kog'Maw will be able to use a basic attack once during Icathian Surprise.
Kog'Maw's usable summoner spells will be placed on a 5 second cooldown upon becoming a zombie.
During Icathian Surprise, Kog'Maw's  attack range is reduced「 to 0 」「 by 500 」, making him automatically path near enemies he is trying to target.
Zombie states trigger upon taking lethal damage.
* Raw damage effects will not prevent zombie states from triggering.
All resurrection effects will take precedence over effects that reanimate as a zombie.
A champion that enters a zombie state will start their death timer upon triggering the effect.
Most buffs and debuffs will be lost upon transitioning into a zombie state.
* Those that persist through death, such as Brand's Blaze, will remain.
* Undisplayed marker buffs, such as those imposed by Veigar's Event Horizon and Viktor's Gravity Field to prevent being affected multiple times by the same effect, will be lost.(bug)
* This does not apply when transitioning from one zombie state to another zombie state.(bug)
Units within a zombie state cannot:
* Use Recall or Refillable Potion.
* Activate resurrection effects.
* Take Dark Passage, Catapult, or gates.
* Initate the Rift Herald Rodeo.
* Pick up the Eye of the Herald.
* Be targeted by the following:
** Bailout
** Chronoshift
** Umbral Trespass.
* Be affected by the following:
** Curse of the Black Mist
** Fear Beyond Death's chain missile
** Test of Spirit's initial missile
** Lamb's Respite
** Realm of Death
** Fountain health restore
